measurements.name: tsb-railway-occurrence-casualty

source.publisher: Transportation Safety Board of Canada (TSB / BST), Rail Occurrence Database System (RODS)
source.requests_note: one GET per RODSdb public CSV from the worker (OCCURRENCE 97,894,047 B / 5.5 s, sha b4aa6cfa...; TRAIN 21,775,681 B / 2.1 s, ea8d99a8...; ROLLING_STOCK 34,758,209 B / 3.5 s, a7e0b143...; INJURIES 2,713,169 B / 1.4 s, c229cb14...; COMPONENTS 42,523 B / 0.6 s, 8f14b197...), all with the browser-like header set recorded in code/build.py - plain HTTP clients are refused (measured 403 anti-scraping); RODS is republished on or soon after the 15th of each month
source.fetch_provenance: worker job tsb-004 (server 171730217, cx23/hel1) fetched the publisher directly; the bytes never passed through the coordinator. The source fetch was reproduced identically by tsb-001/tsb-002 (same five sizes and sha256, last-modified 2026-09-15 vintage) before the panel band was re-pinned

measurements.grain: one row per TSB rail occurrence (occ_no)

label.definition: casualty = 1 iff InjuriesIND == 1 or TotalFatal+TotalSerious+TotalMinor injuries > 0
label.integrity: InjuriesIND and the injury totals agree on all 1,624 positive panel rows (0 disagreements either way) and the separate INJURIES child table corroborates all 1,624; label source columns are excluded from every shipped file
label.publisher_cross_check: TSB 2025 annual summary: panel year 2025 counts 832 ACCIDENT vs 831 published, 331 INCIDENT vs 332 published - within 0.3% of the publisher's own figures

panel.start_rule: first year from which the taxonomy-era share (AccIncType HISTORICAL / DG LEAKER) stays < 0.02 in every later year - measured per year on the full panel, not assumed (the record's proposed 2004 sits inside a measured 6.8% early-taxonomy tail); panel start 2016-01-01, era share 0.58% at 2016 and 0% from 2017
panel.window: 2016-01-01 .. 2026-08-31 (data_max exactly at the window end; the vintage also carries occurrences dated to 2026-10-10, counted and excluded as post-window)

coordinates.note: RODS packs lat/long in three magnitude-disjoint encodings (ddmm.ff packed dominant; decimal-degrees x10^3; x10^6), measured 2026-10-22 over a 3,088-value window with 0 ambiguous and 0 undecodable; the build decodes and requires exactly one decode inside the Canadian envelope [41,72] N / [52,145] W (Ottawa 452500 -> 45deg25.00'N exact). Frame check on the written rows: 0 of 13,732 coordinate values outside the envelope. tsb-003's '5 corrupt source coordinates' diagnosis is corrected in the record: the four occurrences it flagged each decode to exactly one valid Canadian position under the measured three-encoding rule; the defect was the single-scale assumption, not the data

gate.note: passed on the full artifact on the worker (job tsb-004); the gate report ships as qualification.json and the extract as staging release 420246008

reference_baselines.note: measured at construction on the written rows, before any model spend (summary.json reference_baselines); rank AUC
reference_baselines.verdict: real context signal with headroom over the global rate, and the persistence analogue does NOT dominate (0.527 eval) - unlike some panel tasks, this is not a persistence exercise

baseline.note: Measured on the bytes being released (fetched from staging, digest-verified, gate re-accept before scoring), not a rebuild. The model clears the strongest construction-time reference (activity_type 0.707 eval) by +0.106 AUC and the persistence analogue (0.527) by +0.286, so the pre-onset context carries real signal beyond any single column. The holdout was not scored by anything.

discovery_cost.coordinator: 8 ranged HTTP requests (5 size probes + dictionary + 4 era samples + tail) ~= 8.6 MB, < 60 s wall clock; the full 157 MB source was never downloaded to the coordinator
